detail:
PRIME PERERENAN OCEANFRONT
Address Bali is a certified five-star boutique hotel residence on the oceanfront at Pantai Lima, Pererenan — one of Bali's most sought-after and fastest-appreciating stretches of coast, with a surf break at the doorstep and Pererenan's best cafés, restaurants and beach clubs a few minutes away. The land is in Bali's pink (tourism) zone, the PBG building permit has been obtained, and construction is in progress, with completion scheduled for Q2 2028.

OCEAN VIEWS FROM EVERY RESIDENCE
Just 35 residences over four levels, every one with an ocean view. Above them, a 360° oceanfront rooftop brings together the infinity pool, sun decks, restaurant and bar, alongside a sauna and ice bath, a wellness and fitness suite and a Japanese garden. Owners enjoy full five-star hotel services, a 24/7 concierge and the private members' club.

THE RESIDENCES
Fully furnished, hand-crafted interiors with smart-home systems; indicative prices on a 27-year leasehold:
Sea-View Hotel Studio — 33 m², second floor — from $150,000
Garden & Pool Deluxe Suite — 50–58 m², first floor — from $180,000
Sea-View Deluxe Suite — 45–49 m², floors 2–4 — from $200,000
Pool & Garden Master Suite — 67–77 m², first floor — from $225,000
Sea-View Master Suite — 66 m², floors 2–3 — from $250,000
The Corner Residence — 85 m², sea & river views — from $275,000
Junior Penthouse — 66 m², fourth floor — $275,000 (one remaining)
A further 10 years of lease can be added for 10% of the price. Floor plans for all four levels are in the gallery.

INVESTMENT & PAYMENT
A lifestyle investment with a projected 12–14% ROI, backed by the oceanfront location and in-house hotel management. Secure a residence with a refundable $2,000 deposit; the first payment starts from $45,000, with the balance staged through construction to delivery.

KEY FACTS
Location: Pantai Lima, Pererenan — oceanfront
Certified five-star boutique hotel residences
Pink (tourism) land zone · PBG obtained · construction in progress
Ocean views from every residence · 360° oceanfront rooftop with hotel amenities
Leasehold: 27 years, +10-year extension available
Completion: Q2 2028
From $150,000 (ocean-view studio) · first payment from $45,000 · projected ROI 12–14%
